title: Storemate
tagline: Storemate helps you to prevent losing your IPFS data thereby preserving the on chain assets built on it
description: As of today a lot of important assets are built on top of IPFS. In terms of general perception everyone things that once their data is on IPFS, it is immutable and perserved forever. While the first argument holds, the second doesn't and its dependent on an intricate set of things happening in the background to keep the data available. Storemate helps users understand the risk to their assets and IPFS data by showing all their assets that are linked to IPFS, allowing users to set bounties for IPFS storage providers to host the data and allowing users to subscribe to personaized Push notifications based on their data's pinning and deals.
